SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND FROM KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 WHERE CSTMR_ID = 'KRKTPI0001C001' AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05 ','RE06 ')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT DECODE(RQ02.USE_CHK,'N','D','C') AS STATUS, SUBSTR(RQ02.QUOTA_SBMT_DATM,1,8) AS ADD_DATE, SUBSTR(RQ02.QUOTA_SBMT_DATM,9,6) AS ADD_TIME, RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_NO||RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_SEQ AS QUOTATION_NO, NVL(TRIM(RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_SEQ),SUBSTR(RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_NO,9,3)) AS SEQ, RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_RND AS REVISION_NO, RQ02.GDS_CD AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, RQ02.UNIT_CD AS UNIT_MEASURE, GETALANCINFO(RQ03.SPPLR_ID,'BIZ_NO') AS SELLER, GETALANCINFO(RQ03.SPPLR_ID,'ALANC_NM') AS SELLER_COMPANY_NAME, ( SELECT USR_NM FROM KEPCOUR01 WHERE ALANC_ID = RQ03.SPPLR_ID AND USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS SELLER_NAME, ( SELECT PHON_NO FROM KEPCOUR01 WHERE ALANC_ID = RQ03.SPPLR_ID AND USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS SELLER_TEL, TO_CHAR(RQ03.SLS_UNTPRC,'999999999999.00') AS UNIT_PRICE, SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_SINGLE_BYTE(RTRIM(RQ02.ADMNCMPY_NOTE )),' '),1,300) AS REMARK FROM KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 RQ02, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ04 RQ04, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ03 RQ03 WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$ AND RQ02.PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05','RE06') AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RE_NO AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_SEQ AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_RND AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_NO AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_RND AND RQ03.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND RQ04.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND RQ03.SUBID_CHK = 'Y'
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 RQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 RQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'E', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
